title: Aokishi Bunny
description: Scarlett Arman is no ordinary lady, not just because she’s engaged to the emperor. Newly reincarnated as a character in a fantasy novel, Scarlett knows she is supposed to die a horrible death at the hands of her fiancé, Charleon Kalior. Determined to escape her fate, Scarlett decides to make Charleon break off the engagement… But why does he keep wanting to spend time with her?!
